answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before trading, tied to a verified work history rather than a fresh identity. A newcomer enters through a narrow inlet: it may serve only one small island of users and handle tiny transactions from a single jetty. Reaching more islands demands a longer honest record and a bigger stake, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand deposits and a thousand slow reputations, far more than any Sybil attack gains.
